name: Feasibility: Integrations and data architecture (cross-cutting)
description:
Not a PRD feature area, but the PRD's highest-severity risk and the prerequisite for every other analysis in this epic: _"Integration with existing CRM and Salesforce — risk of delays and technical obstacles. Mitigation: verify feasibility ASAP."_

h2. Scope

Must-have integrations per PRD: Salesforce + 123FormBuilder (CRM core, forms, pipeline, status sync), internal CRM/CMS (partner and add-on management, e-shop admin access), Keboola (data pipeline, duplicate check).

Nice-to-have: DocuSign, GitHub, Office 365 / Outlook, HubSpot, WordPress.

h2. To analyse

- Bidirectional data sync portal ↔ CRM ↔ Salesforce — who owns master data for each entity (OQ-19)
- WordPress: retain or replace with a new frontend — blocks the overall architecture (OQ-20)
- Data quality audit before development — inconsistent WP/SF data may complicate display
- Available APIs, rate limits, auth model and sandbox availability for each must-have system
- Where the portal itself would run and what it owns as its own data
- DevRel team capacity as a delivery constraint (OQ-18)

h2. Output

Target integration architecture sketch, master-data ownership table, per-system gap list, and the ordered set of decisions the MVP scope depends on.
